summary: Iteration 12 - tested toolset revamp: new header/nav/footer/video-BG library, Layers-as-own-tab + Blend tab, code-view HTML|CSS|Inline toggle, CDN-aware 'From your CDNs' block surfacing, Import/Export hub modal (export + send-to + paste/url import), Product Catalog Sync button, Shop 'Thank You' add-page, and /api/import/url backend endpoint. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with TestImportUrl (3 new tests) - full pytest run 53/53 passed (all previous 50 + 3 new). New backend endpoint POST /api/import/url returns {status:200, html:<non-empty>} for https://example.com (verified 'example' in body) and returns 400 for both 'notaurl' and empty string. Frontend Playwright (1920x1080, tour dismissed via localStorage): (1) Library tab shows new Navbars/Headers/Footers/Video BG categories - Video BG's three items 'Hero-Video Background', 'Section-Video+Text', 'Video Banner Strip' visible in sidebar screenshot; double-click insert of a header/footer/video-hero grew canvas 0->3. (2) Right sidebar now has Layers as its own tab (data-testid insp-tab-layers) - 23 layer elements rendered. (3) Blend tab: blend-panel renders; clicking mix-multiply with an element selected injects mix-blend-mode:multiply into the wrapped element HTML (verified via el.innerHTML contains 'multiply'); bgmix-screen and blend-isolate click without error; blend-apply-overlay wraps selected element in an overlay div and inserts mix-blend-mode into the resulting markup. (4) Code view: mode-code activates; codeview-html/codeview-css/codeview-inline all present. CSS output length 2292 with braces (contains rules like 'body{...}', '.el-0 {...}'). HTML output length 1696 and references 'styles.css'. Inline output length 3424 and contains 'og:...' meta plus '<!doctype'. (5) CDN awareness: from insp-tab-cdn, cdn-toggle-bootstrap5 enables Bootstrap; switching to left-tab-library, a 'FROM YOUR CDNS' section appears with data-testid='cdn-tools' listing BS Navbar/Card/Alert/Buttons; cdn-block-bs-navbar double-click inserts to canvas (0->1). (6) TopBar export-btn -> export-more opens transfer-modal; all export tab testids present (exp-standalone, exp-zip, exp-json, exp-copy, send-figma/webflow/framer/wordpress/netlify); all six send/copy actions click without JS errors and fire toast callbacks. Import tab shows imp-url-input, imp-url-btn, imp-paste-textarea, imp-paste-btn. Paste with a valid section HTML fires doPaste -> onImportSections which correctly opens the 'Imported sections' chooser (importOpen state) - modal displays the parsed section for insertion. (7) left-tab-shop -> wire-catalog-btn present, clicks without error. (8) Add Page -> Shop -> add-page-item-shop-thankyou -> add-page-confirm creates a new page and canvas renders green check + 'Thank you for your order!' heading (visible in screenshot). (9) Regression: BG tab still shows Background Music/Image/Video sections (screenshot); Layers/Motion/Theme/CDN/Page tabs all remain. Only console noise: DialogContent missing aria-describedby - accessibility warning, not functional.

design_issues.screen: transfer-modal (Import/Export dialog) and Add Page dialog
issues: DialogContent renders without a Description or aria-describedby attribute - Radix Dialog logs an a11y warning in the console. Add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined} intent) to silence and improve screen-reader UX.

action_items: (optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to ImportExportModal and Add-Page dialog to remove the 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ImportExportModal.jsx and Builder.jsx Add-Page dialog render DialogContent without a DialogDescription; Radix logs a11y warnings. Cheap fix: add <DialogDescription className='sr-only'>...</DialogDescription> inside DialogHeader.

importHtml.scanHtml() successfully parses fragments (uses DOMParser which wraps in <html><body>); paste import correctly routes through onImportSections -> chooser modal. The chooser (importedSections dialog) still requires the user to click each section to insert it. That is expected UX, but consider a bulk 'Insert all sections' button so a single-section paste feels one-click.
cdnComponents.js keys off isLibInHead(headHtml, libId); CDNPanel's cdn-toggle-<id> writes to headHtml, so the surfacing is data-driven and works. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of specified feature checks - new library categories present and inserting, Layers tab standalone, Blend mix + overlay apply, Code view HTML|CSS|Inline all switch and produce correct outputs, CDN toggling surfaces From-your-CDNs blocks, transfer modal export/send buttons don't crash, paste import opens chooser, wire-catalog-btn present, Thank You page creates and renders. Only warning is a Radix a11y console warning.

seed_data_creation: None (import test fetched public https://example.com; no persistent state left).
